minutes_text:
Arts Commission

  Inglewood, California
  October 15, 2025

A meeting of the Inglewood Arts Commission convened on October 15, 2025. Chairman
Jacques Lesure called the meeting to order at 6:30 p.m., followed by the flag salute.

Ramara Rubin announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:
   Commissioner Aletha Metcalf - District 1
   Commissioner Phyllis Battle - District 3
   Chairman Jacques Lesure - Commissioner at Large
  Absent:
   Commissioner Olivia Alvitre - District 2
   Commissioner Vickie Perryman-Banks - District 4

City Personnel present were as follows:

   Kerri Arroyo  Library Director
   Ramara Rubin  Secretary

PUBLIC COMMENTS.
a. MonaLisa Whitaker, expresses support for continuing public art workshops and
  inquires about public art fund balance.

MINUTES. Commissioner Battle moved, and Commissioner Metcalf seconded, that the
minutes for the Arts Commission meeting held on July 16, 2025 be approved.
The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
Ayes: Commissioners Metcalf, Lesure, and Battle
Noes: None
   Arts Commission

  VERBAL REPORTS-Public Art‐Related Projects.
  a. Phase 1 - Utility Box Art Program was discussed with Commissioner Metcalf
  suggesting all utility boxes be wrapped, including those owned by private
  companies.
  b. Helen Lessick presented final report on the public art workshops and
  expressed the importance of artists in public dialog, free art workshops for
  adults and youth, funding for artist-led projects, and municipal public art
  commissions for upcoming events.
  c. Kerri Arroyo, Library Director, provided an update on the library, mentioning
  the closure of the Main Library and the shift to the Crenshaw-Imperial
  Branch. Arroyo discussed ongoing conversation projects such as the History of
  Transportation Mural by Helen Lundeberg and the movement of public art
  pieces to various locations.
  d. Kerri Arroyo, Library Director, provided an overview of the Request for
  Proposal reference document for hiring a Public Art Consultant and outlined
  the projected timeline.

PUBLIC REMARKS.
  a. MonaLisa Whitaker proposed utilizing funds from the Public Art Fund to
  support the creation of an Arts and Cultural Affairs department.
  b. Joyce Dallal of Inglewood Open Studios (IOS) shared an opportunity to apply
  for the “Small Works Group Pop-up Show” at Black House LA, noting the
  upcoming application deadline and highlighting the variety of planned
  programming.
  c. Commissioner Lesure highlighted the success of YOLA Beckman’s Gracias
  Gustavo event, featuring live art, music, and community activities.

COMMISSIONERS’ COMMENTS/INITIATIVES/ART CALENDAR. None

There being no further business to be presented, Chairman Lesure declared the meeting
adjourned at 7:20 p.m.
